cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/submission")
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/tests")
from main import run_request
from naive_ref import run_reference

req = {"streams":[{"topology":{
  "nodes":[{"id":0,"name":"A","external_capacity":100},{"id":1,"name":"B","external_capacity":100}],
  "links":[{"source":0,"target":1,"capacity":10}],
  "external_nodes":["A","B"]},
  "settings":{"trials":2,"epsilon":0,"seed":7,"cutoff":[0,1],"bias":0,"tau":0,"gamma":[1,1],"cache_slots":0},
  "events":[
   {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":{
     "low_A_egress_to_B":{"perturbed":8},
     "low_B_ingress_from_A":{"perturbed":9},
     "low_B_egress_to_A":{"perturbed":3},
     "low_A_ingress_from_B":{"perturbed":4},
     "low_A_origination":{"perturbed":5},
     "low_A_termination":{"perturbed":6},
     "low_B_origination":{"perturbed":7},
     "low_B_termination":{"perturbed":2}}},
   {"op":"repair","id":"r"}]}]}

# hand-derived expectation (see notes):
expected_links = [[-1,0,5,2,1],[-1,1,3,2,1],[0,-1,6,2,1],[0,1,9,2,1],[1,-1,2,2,1],[1,0,10,2,1]]
expected_order = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,-1],[0,1],[-1,1],[1,-1]]

mine = json.loads(json.dumps(run_request(copy.deepcopy(req))))
ref = json.loads(json.dumps(run_reference(copy.deepcopy(req))))
rep = mine["streams"][0]["events"][1]
print("mine links:", rep["links"])
print("mine order:", rep["order"])
print("ref links :", ref["streams"][0]["events"][1]["links"])
print("ref order :", ref["streams"][0]["events"][1]["order"])
assert mine == ref, "engine/ref mismatch"
assert rep["links"] == expected_links, "links mismatch vs hand derivation"
assert rep["order"] == expected_order, "order mismatch vs hand derivation"
assert all(v["confidence"] == [2,1] for v in rep["counters"].values())
print("HAND-DERIVED CASE MATCHES BOTH IMPLEMENTATIONS")
EOF
